# Sam Walby

> Freelance writer, editor and interviewer based in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, UK.

Sam Walby is a freelance writer, editor and interviewer based in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, with nearly 20 years of experience in independent magazine publishing, social enterprise and community initiatives. He was Editor-in-Chief of Now Then Magazine from 2009 to 2026.

## Services
- Writing: long-form articles, Q&A transcripts, insight reports and reflections
- Editing: developmental editing through to fine-detail copy editing and proofreading
- Interviewing: generative, supportive conversations
- Bid writing: grant funding applications
- Project design & management

## Location
Sheffield, South Yorkshire, UK. Available for remote work worldwide.
